newsitem.title: UK: HSBC sees organic growth at Midland.
newsitem.headline: HSBC sees organic growth at Midland.

text.p: HSBC Holdings chief executive John Bond said he expects its UK retail banking unit Midland Bank to continue to grow organically since the price of potential acquisitions looks too high.
"Our strategy is unabashedly to grow the business, in doing it organically, we've gained market share in nearly every part of Midland's business," Bond told Reuters in an interview.
Midland raised it pre-tax profit by 27 percent 1.272 billion stg.
"We don't rule out acquisition, we have nothing on the agenda at present, but it's hard to see some of the prices work for our shareholders that we see around," Bond added.
